response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile individual-contributor engineer with deep technical breadth (testing frameworks, developer tools like Fluent-Asserts and Trial, CI/CD setup, workshops on testing) but his resume shows no evidence of people management or team leadership experience — all roles are IC titles (Senior/Staff Software Developer/Engineer) with no mention of managing reports, conducting one-on-ones, or leading organizational change. This is a people-management role requiring 2+ years of direct team leadership, which is a hard requirement he does not meet.
strengths: Deep experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium courses, CI/CD setup)
18+ years of broad technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos
concerns: No evidence of formal people-management experience (no direct reports, performance reviews, or one-on-ones mentioned)
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or strategic roadmap planning at an org level
No mobile-platform-specific experience relevant to the large mobile ecosystem focus of this role
